title: OPEN MY EYES LORD

lines.text: To reach out and touch Him
And say that I love Him,

chords:
[Verse 1]
[D]Open my eyes, Lord,
[A]I want to see Jesus,
To reach out and touch Him
[D]And say that I love Him,

[Verse 2]
Open my ears, Lord,
[A]And teach me to listen,
Open my heart, Lord,
[D]I want to love Jesus.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Open my eyes, Lord,
I want to see Jesus,
To reach out and touch Him
And say that I love Him,

[Verse 2]
Open my ears, Lord,
And teach me to listen,
Open my heart, Lord,
I want to love Jesus.
